verdict.rationale: Bolt supports iterative prompting and reverting via code view/version history, and some users report successful prompt-only iteration (bolt-comm-10, bolt-comm-3), but multiple hands-on accounts describe a 'doom loop' where fixes break previously working features (bolt-comm-9) and even unauthorized destructive changes to critical systems like payments (bolt-comm-7), directly contradicting the 'without breaking what already works' claim.
